/* selectKeyValue - Lee MS */
SELECT ISRY_APP.SA_FN_GET_RENU_NO('EA', #{USER_ID}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')) FROM DUAL

/* selectEmrgRptById - Lee MS */
SELECT A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건대분류구분코드 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건중분류구분코드 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건소분류구분코드 */ A.INCDNT_TTL_NM AS INCDNT_TTL_NM, /* 사건제목명 */ A.INCDNT_OCRN_YMD AS INCDNT_OCRN_YMD, /* 사건발생일자 */ A.OCRN_RPT_YMD AS OCRN_RPT_YMD, /* 발생보고일자 */ A.INCDNT_CN AS INCDNT_CN, /* 사건내용 */ A.INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN AS INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN, /* 사건관련규모내용 */ A.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO, /* 담당자번호 */ A.INST_NO AS INST_NO, /* 기관번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(C.FLNM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM, /* 담당자명 */ C.WRD_TELNO AS WRD_TELNO, /* 유선전화번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(C.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO, /* 휴대전화번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(C.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR, /* 이메일 */ D.CTPV_NM AS CTPV_NM, /* 시도명 */ D.SGG_NM AS SGG_NM, /* 시군구명 */ A.RM_CN AS RM_CN, /* 비고내용 */ A.ATFINO AS ATFINO, /* 첨부화일번호 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO, /* 긴급대응사건번호 */ E.EMRG_CNTRMS_TRMN_NO AS EMRG_CNTRMS_TRMN_NO /* 긴급대응종결번호 */ FROM ACA700 A, SAA000 B, SCA100 C, SAA020 D, ACA720 E /* 통합기관(B), 종사자(C) 시군구코드(D), 긴급대응조치 (E) */ WHERE A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND B.SGG_CD = D.SGG_CD(+) AND A.PIC_NO = C.ENFSN_NO AND A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = E.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO(+) AND A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}

/* selectReqById - Lee MS */
SELECT A.ACTN_RPT_YMD AS ACTN_RPT_YMD, /* 조치보고일자 */ A.ACTN_TTL_NM AS ACTN_TTL_NM, /* 조치제목명 */ A.ACTN_MATTER_CN AS ACTN_MATTER_CN, /* 조치사항내용 */ A.HNCFRT_ACTN_PLAN_CN AS HNCFRT_ACTN_PLAN_CN, /* 향후조치계획 */ A.UP_INST_DMND_CN AS UP_INST_DMND_CN, /* 상위기관요청 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO, /* 긴급대응조치번호 */ A.INCDNT_NO_SN AS INCDNT_NO_SN /* 사건번호일련번호 */ FROM ACA710 A /* 긴급대응조치 */ WHERE A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}
mapper.update:
/* saveData - Lee MS */
MERGE INTO ACA710 /* 긴급대응조치 */ USING DUAL ON (EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO} AND INCDNT_NO_SN = #{INCDNT_NO_SN}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ACTN_TTL_NM = #{ACTN_TTL_NM}, /* 조치제목명 */ ACTN_RPT_YMD = #{ACTN_RPT_YMD}, /* 조치보고일자 */ ACTN_MATTER_CN = #{ACTN_MATTER_CN}, /* 조치사항내용 */ HNCFRT_ACTN_PLAN_CN = #{HNCFRT_ACTN_PLAN_CN}, /* 향후조치계획 */ UP_INST_DMND_CN = #{UP_INST_DMND_CN}, /* 상위기관요청 */ PIC_NO = #{PIC_NO}, /* 담당자번호 */ INST_NO = #{INST_NO}, /* 기관번호 */ LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID}, /* 최종수정자아이디 */ LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO, /* 긴급대응사건번호 */ INCDNT_NO_SN, /* 사건번호일련번호 */ ACTN_TTL_NM, /* 조치제목명 */ ACTN_RPT_YMD, /* 조치보고일자 */ ACTN_MATTER_CN, /* 조치사항내용 */ HNCFRT_ACTN_PLAN_CN, /* 향후조치계획 */ UP_INST_DMND_CN, /* 상위기관요청 */ PIC_NO, /* 담당자번호 */ INST_NO, /* 기관번호 */ FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(INCDNT_NO_SN),0)+1 FROM ACA710 WHERE EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = #{EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO}), #{ACTN_TTL_NM}, #{ACTN_RPT_YMD}, #{ACTN_MATTER_CN}, #{HNCFRT_ACTN_PLAN_CN}, #{UP_INST_DMND_CN}, #{PIC_NO}, #{INST_NO}, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{USER_ID}, SYSDATE )
